# ARGUS Tracking & Weapon Detection Test Fixtures Manifest

This directory contains deterministic evaluation video fixtures for the ARGUS multi-object tracking and weapon detection subsystems.

## Fixture Inventory & Provenance

| Fixture File | Duration | Resolution | FPS | Provenance & Source Material | Type | Ground-Truth Classes | Purpose / Test Scenario |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `fixture_pistol.mp4` | 3.0s (30 fr) | 416x416 | 10.0 | Hugging Face / Roboflow `phil20/weapon` (`pistol/pistol10*`) | Image-sequence compilation | `Pistol` (handgun/firearm) | Handgun brandishing, firearm detection and track continuity |
| `fixture_knife.mp4` | 3.0s (30 fr) | 416x416 | 10.0 | Hugging Face / Roboflow `phil20/weapon` (`knife/knife8*`) | Image-sequence compilation | `Knife` (edged blade) | Bladed weapon detection, small object handling and tracking |
| `fixture_rifle.mp4` | 3.0s (30 fr) | 416x416 | 10.0 | Hugging Face / Roboflow `phil20/weapon` (`rifle/rifle10*`) | Image-sequence compilation | `Rifle` (long-barrel firearm) | Long gun identification, high-threat weapon tracking |
| `fixture_person_normal.mp4` | 3.0s (30 fr) | 320x240 | 10.0 | UCF-Crime CCTV Dataset (`Normal_Videos_247_x264.mp4` at t=2.0s) | Real CCTV footage | `person` | Real multi-person surveillance tracking without weapons |
| `fixture_normal_no_weapon.mp4` | 3.0s (30 fr) | 640x360 | 10.0 | Synthetic security simulation (`sample_normal_patrol.mp4` at t=0.5s) | Synthetic / Simulated scene | No weapons | Negative control verifying zero false-positive weapon alerts |
| `fixture_stealing_phone.mp4` | 3.0s (30 fr) | 320x240 | 10.0 | UCF-Crime CCTV Dataset (`Stealing050_x264.mp4` at t=15.0s) | Real CCTV footage | `person`, `cell phone` / personal belongings | Stealing-specific target object detection & interaction cues |
| `fixture_difficult_night.mp4` | 3.0s (30 fr) | 640x360 | 10.0 | Synthetic night simulation (`sample_night_intrusion.mp4` at t=2.0s) | Synthetic / Simulated scene | Low ambient, dark sensor noise | Low-light test verifying detector stability and absence of spurious detections |

## License and Ethical Attribution
- `phil20/weapon` dataset images are provided under Open Access / Academic Research attribution.
- UCF-Crime video benchmarks (`Normal_Videos_247_x264.mp4`, `Stealing050_x264.mp4`) are licensed for non-commercial computer vision evaluation and security research.
- Synthetic fixtures (`sample_normal_patrol.mp4`, `sample_night_intrusion.mp4`) were generated locally as algorithmic test fixtures.
- Weapon detections generated by ARGUS are AI-assisted triage indicators subject to human operator review.
